Program Regulations and Curriculum Structure

Policy framework, credit model, and syllabus mapping used across UG, PG, and professional tracks.

Regulation Highlights

  • Credit-based semester system
  • Outcome-based course design
  • Continuous internal assessment policy
  • Attendance and condonation norms

Assessment Pattern

  • Assignments and quizzes
  • Two internal examinations
  • Laboratory continuous evaluation
  • End semester examination

Syllabus Governance

  • Board of Studies review cycle
  • Industry and alumni feedback inputs
  • Department-level revision workflow
  • Approval through Academic Council
